name: unity_ads-mcp
description: Unity Ads (ads): me, list_accounts, list_campaigns, update_budget, pause_resume. Every tool maps to

platform_mcp_unity_ads_key_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_UNITY_ADS_KEY_ID
platform_mcp_unity_ads_key_id.description: Key ID of a Unity service account (Unity Cloud dashboard > Administration > Service accounts) with an Advertise API role (Viewer for reads, Campaigns Editor or Admin for budget changes); the HTTP Basic username.

platform_mcp_unity_ads_secret_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_UNITY_ADS_SECRET_KEY
platform_mcp_unity_ads_secret_key.description: The service account's secret key, the HTTP Basic password.

platform_mcp_unity_ads_organization_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_UNITY_ADS_ORGANIZATION_ID
platform_mcp_unity_ads_organization_id.description: Unity organization id (core id) that owns the Unity Ads advertiser apps; part of every path.

platform_mcp_unity_ads_campaign_set_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_UNITY_ADS_CAMPAIGN_SET_ID
platform_mcp_unity_ads_campaign_set_id.description: App (campaign set) id used by update_budget, since budget calls are addressed as /apps/{campaignSetId}/campaigns/{campaignId}/budget. Take it from list_accounts.

tools.name: me
tools.description: There is no account endpoint; the probe is GET /advertise/v1/organizations/{organization_id}/apps?limit=1, which verifies the service account and its Advertise role on the organization.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: GET /apps: the organization's advertised apps (campaign sets). Unity Ads groups campaigns per app, so each app `id` (campaignSetId) is what list_campaigns takes as account_id. Budgets are in USD.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: GET /apps/{campaignSetId}/campaigns[?filter[enabled]=true|false]: the app's campaigns. status accepts active/enabled (enabled=true) or paused/disabled (enabled=false); the `enabled` boolean is returned in its own field (no string status exists). Budgets are a separate resource (GET …/campaigns/{campaignId}/budget), so `budget` is not mapped. `page`/`limit` are not sent.

tools.name: update_budget
tools.description: PATCH /apps/{campaign_set_id}/campaigns/{campaign_id}/budget {daily: "<USD, up to 2 decimals>"} (a partial update: the total budget is unchanged; 0 disables the daily cap). This spends money. Unity recommends at least $500 per country daily for CPI campaigns. Campaigns using per-country daily budgets (dailyPerCountry) are not changed by this call. Needs the campaign_set_id config field (the app the campaign belongs to). `currency` is ignored (USD).

tools.name: pause_resume
tools.description: PATCH /apps/{campaign_set_id}/campaigns/{campaign_id} {"enabled": false|true} (a partial campaign update). Needs the campaign_set_id config field (the app the campaign belongs to). Unity limits updates to one per second and 100 per 30 minutes per campaign.
